title: Original multiscale scene with occlusion

source.text: An original flat-color scene on a pale background contains five shapes of unequal size at irregular positions: a purple ring at upper left, an orange vertical capsule at upper right, a large blue irregular quadrilateral across the center and lower area, a coral horizontal bar at lower left, and a smaller green star at lower right. The coral bar is drawn over part of the blue shape. The ring has a background-colored opening. The image supplies no physical scale, material, function, provenance of real objects, or temporal event.
source.notes: One independently authored language-neutral scene, reused in Chinese and English. Original Pillow generator and visible-support pixel records are in assets/. Five unequal, irregularly placed shapes include partial occlusion; no third-party image, real photo, or image model was used. Reviewer annotations are not generation context. This synthetic scene does not establish natural-image generalization.
